cases.title: OSIRIS-REx sample-return operations through September 2023
cases.decision_prompt: A sample-return operations team is allocating its September 2023 recovery, curation, and communications capacity after NASA publishes the OSIRIS-REx return press kit. Choose whether to retain the full September recovery plan on the expectation that the Bennu sample capsule will land successfully by month-end, or rebaseline the primary operations plan beyond September.
cases.forecast_question: Using only information available at the cutoff, forecast the probability that "Rebaseline beyond September" is the outcome-aligned action at the stated horizon.

options.label: Rebaseline beyond September
options.description: Move the primary recovery and curation plan beyond September and reduce commitments tied to a September landing.

options.label: Retain the September recovery plan
options.description: Keep recovery, curation, and communications capacity committed to a successful sample landing by the end of September.

sources.title: OSIRIS-REx Asteroid Sample Return Mission Press Kit

cases.title: Artemis I launch operations through September 2022
cases.decision_prompt: NASA has completed the Artemis I flight-readiness review and declared the uncrewed mission go for an August 29 launch attempt. A launch-operations team must decide whether to keep September staffing, range, and mission-support capacity committed to a launch by month-end or rebaseline the primary plan beyond September.
cases.forecast_question: Using only information available at the cutoff, forecast the probability that "Rebaseline beyond September" is the outcome-aligned action at the stated horizon.

options.label: Rebaseline beyond September
options.description: Move the primary launch-operations plan beyond September while preserving bounded readiness for earlier attempts.

options.label: Retain the September launch plan
options.description: Keep staffing, range, and mission-support commitments centered on an Artemis I launch by the end of September.

sources.title: Artemis I Flight Readiness Concludes; NASA Go for August 29 Launch
